The interface language of a page is set with `?lang=en` or"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" `?lang=zh`; the case content is never translated."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Principle"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Role | Does | Determinism |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Model | reads documents, extracts facts, understands meaning | the result may differ from run to r"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"un |
| Engine | draws the diagram according to the specification | the same JSON gives the same diag"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ram, whichever model wrote it |
| JSON specification | the only interface between the two | versione"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"d (see spec/versioning.md) |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The engine does not write JSON, and the Agent does not draw. The model puts information into JSON; t"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"he engine draws. The JSON specification is a specification of its own, for four reasons:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. General-purpose charting syntax is built on nodes, edges and state machines, and has no place for"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" procedural standing or the source of a piece of evidence.
2. The diagram does not depend on which m"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"odel extracted the information.
3. The same JSON gives the same diagram at any time and in any envir"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"onment, so a diagram handed to a court or to the other side can be reproduced.
4. The source is reco"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"rded when the facts are extracted: each fact states the document, the page and the provision it rest"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"s on, and the diagram shows them. The materials themselves are neither bundled nor linked."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Agent Integration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The reference material for an Agent, for the fact diagram, is a field table of about 3.4k characters"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" and a mechanism note of about 6.3k characters."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Skill"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The Skill is in `skills/antu/`; each release also carries it as `antu-skill-<version>.zip`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The command line asks the npm registry once a day whether a newer Antu is out (one GET request, noth"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ing of any diagram) and, if so, ends its output with a notice. `ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns it "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"of any diagram) and, if so, ends its output with a notice. `ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns it off."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### MCP"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The MCP server is the npm package `@zh-xx/antu`, registered as `io.github.zh-xx/antu` in the MCP reg"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"P server is the npm package `@zh-xx/antu`, registered as `io.github.zh-xx/antu` in the MCP registry."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Tools: `antu_schema`, `antu_guide`, `antu_examples`, `antu_validate`, `antu_layout`, `antu_render`, "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"`antu_preview`, `antu_versions`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"A native DSH plugin, `@zh-xx/antu-dsh` (Host tools + a chat card with a picker of the way of drawing"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"), is on npm: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zh-xx/antu-dsh`, then restart DSH. It needs DSH 0.2."},{"id":"p31s3","text":"0-rc.2 or newer. How it works and how it is tested: docs/dsh/dsh-plugin.md and tools/dsh/README.md. "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"A profile that cannot use the plugin can still attach `antu-mcp` with a configuration-only bundle; t"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"he recipe and its limits are in tools/dsh/README.md."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## In an Application"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The same package has entries for an application's own code (spec/embed.md):"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Contracts** under `spec/` (what makes a JSON file or API call valid): versioning, themes, paper "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"size, the MCP server, embedding, source types, and the diagram schemas (fact, procedure, relationshi"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"p, justification). Agent mechanism notes: `spec/agent/`.
- **Design and reference** under `docs/`: a"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"rchitecture, layout engines, React Flow features, fact rendering, DSH plugin plan (install notes in "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"tools/dsh/README.md).
- CHANGELOG.md. Known problems: GitHub issues. Working rules: CONTRIBUTING.md."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- To report a vulnerability, use the private report described in SECURITY.md; please do not open a p"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ublic issue for it.
- Every version of `@zh-xx/antu` and `@zh-xx/antu-dsh` on npm is published by Gi"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"tHub Actions through npm's trusted publisher, with provenance: the page of the version on npm links "},{"id":"p38s4","text":"back to the commit and the workflow run that made it. deps.dev shows the same record, with the known"},{"id":"p38s5","text":" advisories (none at the time of writing) and the licence.
- A page made with Antu works offline and"},{"id":"p38s6","text":" sends nothing anywhere; the command line asks once a day whether a newer version exists and sends n"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"othing of a diagram (`ANTU_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` turns that off)."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Copyright (C) 2026 Ji Cheng."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
